description: Source code implementing quasi peak detection and spectrum data buffer management for audio processing, including functions for processing input samples, writing peak levels, and managing spectral data buffers.

methods.name: LVPSA_QPD_WritePeak
methods.description: Writes a level value into the spectral data buffer for a specific band and updates the buffer pointer.

methods.name: LVPSA_QPD_Process
methods.description: Performs downsampling, post gain adjustment, quasi peak filtering, and writes spectral levels every 20 ms.
